Bid Information

Print
Bid Number: FY2027-07-001
Bid Title: Coffee Supplies-Citywide Multiple Locations
Category: Finance
Status: Open

Description:

INVITATION FOR SEALED BIDS

The City of Bartlett (Citywide) is seeking bids to provide coffee supplies and equipment for various City departments as per the written specifications.

Bid Information and documents are posted on the City’s website at www.cityofbartlett.org 


Sealed bids are to be received no later than 2:00 pm on Thursday December 3, 2026. All bid packets, with an original and two copies must be labeled “FY2027-07-001 COFFEE SUPPLIES - CITYWIDE” and addressed as follows:

Mayor Sample

City of Bartlett

6400 Stage Rd.

Bartlett, TN 38134


Bidders may direct inquiries to Brittney Owens, Assistant Finance Director, at 901-555-0106 or email

The City reserves the right to reject any and all bids and to waive any informality in the bidding process.

The City of Bartlett is an equal opportunity employer, and will not discriminate against any individual for any reason.
